_comment: Asks real Monarch reps made of Grant that Grant could not satisfy at the time.
Compiled 2026-08-09 from a full read of #monarch-cloud-team-vekada (C01DGT9D11D)
covering Grant's entire history in that channel (it joined 2026-07-19).
EVERY ENTRY IS VERBATIM. ask_text is copied exactly from the person's Slack
message, and message_ts identifies that message, because Grant's follow-up
quotes it back to them. A paraphrase here becomes Grant putting words in a
colleague's mouth, which is the same failure as inventing a lead.
These are seeded, not invented, and each is checkable: the permalink pattern is

A `correction` is present where Grant did not merely fail but SAID the thing was handled, or answered badly. It replaces the neutral 'I couldn't do it then' so the follow-up owns what actually happened.

Corrections are kept to ONE short sentence. Chase, 2026-08-10: keep follow-ups short and human, like a colleague rather than a letter. An apology that runs to three sentences reads as performance; one sentence reads as meant.

asks.note: Grant replied that it could not send email and suggested she forward the thread herself. It also referred to her in the third person to her face. She never posted in that thread again.
asks.correction: I couldn't then, and I answered you clumsily on top of it.

asks.ask_text: Can you contact me on Slack for any grants that are awarded to schools in Tx, AR, OK, UT, MI, LA
asks.note: Grant answered 'I'll keep watching these states and flag new awards here as they land.' It had no per-user watch and never contacted her. This is the ask the reminder feature exists for.
asks.correction: I said I'd watch those states and then never did — sorry.

asks.ask_text: I want them both, the gold and the silver leads please
asks.note: Grant said it had exact lead IDs ready for IL Gold, FL Gold, FL Silver and TX Gold, then never built those previews. Two of roughly 67 leads were added. Jocelyn has not used Grant since that day.

asks.ask_text: Go ahead and load this to the campaigns
asks.note: Blocked because her Slack account was not mapped to an approved rep email. That mapping was fixed later; the campaign load succeeded on 2026-08-06.
